thread:
Dana Ortiz: quick note — ran a print/export test for dark theme (Graphite Ink) and found legend swatches collapse to near-identical blobs.
Cole Matthews: thanks. is this the small color square next to series names?
Dana Ortiz: yep. sizes 10x10, alpha 0.12, no border. exported PDFs show them nearly indistinguishable in B/W.
Yuki Sato: can we add patterns? stripes/dots/etc for print-mode?
Cole Matthews: pattern SVGs increase asset weight but we can rasterize only for exports. Another approach: enlarge swatches to 14px and add 1px outline + tiny glyph.
Dana Ortiz: glyphs sound good — circle, dash, dot — plus ARIA labels. also the legend text uses `--muted-fg` which reads at ~3.0:1.
PatternBot: theme-scan: legend-text contrast 3.0:1 (fail), swatch-alpha 0.12 (fail for print). Recommend alpha >=0.22, swatch >=12px, add non-color encodings.
Yuki Sato: also noticed axis tick labels (12px) use `--secondary-fg` at 4% lighter. On projectors they vanish. bump to `--secondary-fg: #b9c6d2` for dark.
Cole Matthews: agree. Also heatmap gradients are too subtle — adjacent buckets look same to deuteranopes. Suggest discrete bins with colorblind-safe palette + hatch for export.
Dana Ortiz: proposed palette: #4aa3ff (blue), #ffd07a (warm), #2ab9a3 (teal), #c27bff (violet) — ensure pairwise contrast >3:1 for small swatches.
DesignBot: accessibility-audit: recommend binary encodings for exports, colorblind-safe palette, min 1px strokes for chart lines, legend glyphs for print.
Yuki Sato: one more: inline code pills in logs use `--code-fg: #9aa6b2` on `--code-bg: #11161b` — contrast ~3.1:1. propose `--code-fg: #d7efff` or add 1px inner glow.
Cole Matthews: keep bg, update fg to `#cfeeff` and add `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04)` for separation.
Dana Ortiz: can we add a user setting under Themes: "Export-friendly legends" that toggles patterns for PDF/PNG exports? Default off for visual cleanliness.
Yuki Sato: yes — default accessible on-screen, export-mode forces patterns. also add `?export=print` param to rendering pipeline to enable.
Dana Ortiz: I'll draft a tiny PR: legend swatch alpha -> 0.22, size -> 12px, 1px border, glyph set, code-fg -> #cfeeff, heatmap discrete bins + palette. include before/after export screenshots and contrast numbers.
Cole Matthews: pls tag @design and @frontend. also add note for embeddables (they inherit vars).
DesignBot: change queued: graphite-legend-print-fix.
Dana Ortiz: thanks team :pray:
